cues.title: 分化之后，信息还在吗？
cues.titleEn: After differentiation, is the information still there?
cues.caption: 再生支持信息保留；表达可以改变。
cues.zh: 先看一个结果：胡萝卜韧皮部培养物增殖，随后形成根、茎和叶，长成植株。这是经典过程概括。若发育所需的信息已经全部丢失，这个结果就难以解释；再生支持这些信息仍可保留。现代解释中，同一套遗传信息可以选择不同的表达，产生不同蛋白和结构。跟住图中的DNA程序：复制出来的是RNA，DNA本身没有变成RNA。图示解释原理，不是当年的基因测量。换一种细胞状态或培养条件，能保证再生吗？不能。
cues.en: Start with the outcome: cultured carrot phloem cells proliferate and form roots, shoots and a plant. This reconstructs the classic observation. Losing all information required for development would conflict with that result; regeneration supports retained information. In the modern explanation, different expression programs produce different proteins and structures. Follow the DNA programs: RNA is a separate copy, not DNA changing into RNA. This is an explanatory model, not gene measurements from that experiment. Would a different cell state or culture condition guarantee regeneration? No.

cues.title: 相同条件，比较增殖代数
cues.caption: 同条件比较增殖代数，不能换算个人寿命。
cues.captionEn: Culture generations do not predict lifespan.
cues.zh: 教材比较同样条件下培养的肺成纤维细胞：胎儿来源约五十代，中年来源约二十代，老年来源二到四代。这里保留教材给出的数值与范围。它们是这项比较中的增殖代数，不能换算成人的年龄或寿命，也不代表所有组织细胞。
cues.en: The textbook compares lung fibroblasts cultured under the same conditions: about fifty generations for fetal sources, twenty for middle-aged sources and two to four for older sources. These are the textbook values, not a formula for human age or lifespan and not a rule for every tissue.

cues.title: 分别追踪核与质
cues.caption: 核与质各保留来源；这是教材对照。
cues.captionEn: Track both origins in the textbook comparison.
cues.zh: 先看教材的描述。衰老细胞核移入年轻细胞质，细胞不分裂；年轻细胞核移入衰老细胞质，细胞分裂旺盛。颜色分别保留核和质的来源。这是教材用于讨论细胞核作用的对照。接下来再看原始研究为什么不能被简化成一条普遍的返老还童规则。
cues.en: First follow the textbook account: an old nucleus with young cytoplasm does not divide, while a young nucleus with old cytoplasm divides vigorously. Separate colors preserve nuclear and cytoplasmic origin. This comparison motivates a nuclear contribution; the next evidence shows why it is not a universal rejuvenation rule.

cues.title: 核与质都需要研究
cues.caption: 年轻核不保证恢复旺盛增殖。
cues.captionEn: A young nucleus does not guarantee renewal.
cues.zh: 一九七六年的重组实验中，年轻细胞核与老龄培养物细胞质组成的细胞，多数只有有限分裂。另一项一九八三年的研究发现，衰老细胞质与年轻细胞融合可抑制DNA合成。这些研究条件不同，不能混算结果。它们提醒我们：细胞核和细胞质都可能影响增殖，教材比较有适用边界。
cues.en: In a nineteen seventy-six reconstruction study, young nuclei combined with cytoplasts from older cultures mostly showed limited division. A separate nineteen eighty-three study found that fusion with senescent cytoplasts inhibited DNA synthesis. The experiments differ and their results must not be pooled. Both nucleus and cytoplasm can influence proliferation.

cues.title: 追踪每一个分支
cues.caption: 追踪母子关系，才能确定哪些分支结束。
cues.captionEn: Trace parentage before assigning a cell fate.
cues.zh: 透明的秀丽隐杆线虫让研究者连续追踪细胞来自哪个母细胞，又形成哪些后代。标准雌雄同体的体细胞谱系中，一共产生一千零九十个细胞，其中一百三十一个按程序死亡，保留九百五十九个。画面的小树只说明分支关系，不是完整的真实谱系图；计数也不包含生殖细胞。
cues.en: The transparent nematode allows researchers to trace parent cells and descendants. In the standard hermaphrodite somatic lineage, one thousand ninety cells are generated, one hundred thirty-one undergo programmed death and nine hundred fifty-nine remain. The small tree illustrates branching only; it is not the complete measured lineage, and these counts exclude germ cells.

cues.title: 改变执行，比较命运
cues.caption: 改变执行，同一分支的命运可以改变。
cues.captionEn: Altering execution changes the branch’s fate.
cues.zh: 现在比较同一个示意分支。正常执行时，细胞凝缩并走向凋亡；CED三功能缺失时，原本会死亡的细胞可以保留。这来自遗传干预的证据，不是根据颜色猜命运。这里把CED四到CED三的执行关系简化显示。自由探索还可改变CED四，检验执行是否受阻。改变的是死亡程序，不是让这个细胞从未产生；停止分裂也不等于已经死亡。完整调控网络和其他死亡途径，并没有全部画在这里。
cues.en: Compare the same illustrative branch. With normal execution, the cell condenses and undergoes apoptosis. Loss of CED three function can preserve a cell normally destined to die. Genetic intervention supplies the evidence; color alone does not establish a fate. The diagram simplifies execution from CED four to CED three. Exploration also changes CED four. The intervention alters a death program, not whether the cell was born. Stopping division is not the same as dying, and this diagram does not include every regulatory factor or mode of death.

translations.DNA程序身份不变，选择表达产生独立RNA与蛋白；现代简化解释: DNA programs remain; selected expression produces separate RNA and proteins in a modern schematic
translations.供体核保持身份，受体细胞质保持自己的来源: The donor nucleus retains its identity in recipient cytoplasm
translations.同一示意细胞，正常执行时凝缩，执行受阻时保留: The same illustrative cell condenses with execution and is retained when execution is blocked
translations.培养年龄不同的核与质重组，多数重组细胞仅有限分裂: Recombining differently aged cultures mostly produced limited divisions
translations.局部分支结构示意，保留母子关系和细胞身份: An illustrative local branch preserves parentage and cell identities
translations.比较必需信息丢失假说与完整植株再生的观察: Compare the lost-information hypothesis with whole-plant regeneration
translations.胡萝卜韧皮部细胞经培养增殖，适宜条件下形成根茎叶: Carrot phloem cultures proliferate and regenerate roots and shoots under suitable conditions

question.zh: 分化之后，细胞是否丢失了发育所需的信息？
question.en: Does differentiation remove the information needed for development?

lead.zh: 先看胡萝卜培养物再生，再比较信息丢失与选择表达两种解释。
lead.en: Start with carrot regeneration, then compare information loss with changed expression.

principle.zh: 再生支持分化细胞仍可保留发育所需信息；表达改变可以产生不同结构，但再生具有条件。
principle.en: Regeneration supports retained developmental information; altered expression can produce different structures, under suitable conditions.

question.zh: 未表达的程序是否等于已经丢失？
question.en: Is a program that is not expressed necessarily lost?

explanation.zh: 不等于。解释模型中 DNA 程序保留，改变的是 RNA 与蛋白的产生；真实再生仍须检验细胞状态和培养条件。
explanation.en: No. DNA programs persist while RNA and protein production differs. Actual regeneration still requires suitable cell state and culture conditions.

question.zh: 培养中的增殖代数，能换算人的寿命吗？
question.en: Can culture generations predict human lifespan?

lead.zh: 保留同一培养条件，比较教材的来源组与原始范围。
lead.en: Keep conditions matched and compare textbook source groups and ranges.

principle.zh: 这项比较关联细胞来源与体外增殖表现，不能给出所有组织或个体的寿命公式。
principle.en: The comparison associates source with in-vitro proliferation; it is not a lifespan formula for every tissue or individual.

question.zh: 如果培养条件也变了，还能只归因于来源年龄吗？
question.en: If culture conditions also differ, can the result be attributed only to source age?

explanation.zh: 不能；额外条件形成混杂。已记录的 50、20、2–4 不会因界面假设而改变。
explanation.en: No; the extra change confounds attribution. Recorded 50, 20 and 2–4 values remain fixed.

question.zh: 换入年轻细胞核，细胞就必然恢复年轻吗？
question.en: Does a young nucleus guarantee a young cell?

lead.zh: 先追踪教材核质交换的两种来源，再看独立研究的反例与限制。
lead.en: Track both origins in the textbook account, then examine independent limits.

principle.zh: 核与质都可影响增殖；不同研究条件和培养年龄不能合成一个普遍返老还童结论。
principle.en: Nucleus and cytoplasm can both affect proliferation; different conditions do not establish a universal rejuvenation rule.

question.zh: 年轻核与衰老质重组，是否能保证旺盛分裂？
question.en: Does a young nucleus with old cytoplasm guarantee vigorous division?

explanation.zh: 不能。1976 年特定培养重组实验多见有限分裂；1983 年不同实验还显示衰老细胞质可抑制 DNA 合成。
explanation.en: No. A 1976 reconstruction study mostly found limited division; a different 1983 study found inhibition of DNA synthesis by senescent cytoplasts.

question.zh: 有些细胞为何产生后又被去除？
question.en: Why are some cells generated and then removed?

lead.zh: 追踪母细胞与后代，再比较同一分支在死亡执行受阻时的命运。
lead.en: Trace parentage, then compare a branch when death execution is blocked.

principle.zh: 固定的发育命运与基因干预证据支持受调控的细胞死亡；死亡不是停止分裂的同义词。
principle.en: Reproducible fates and genetic intervention support regulated death; cessation of division is not death.

question.zh: 失去关键死亡执行功能，是否表示那个细胞从未产生？
question.en: Does loss of death execution mean the cell was never born?

explanation.zh: 不是。示意分支的母子关系保持，变化发生在后续命运；部分原本死亡的细胞可存活。
explanation.en: No. Parentage is preserved and the later fate changes; cells normally destined to die can survive.

topicSuggestion.title: 细胞命运：信息、来源与执行
topicSuggestion.titleEn: Cell fates: information, origins and execution
topicSuggestion.description: 由再生、培养和遗传干预的证据，区分分化、衰老与死亡。
topicSuggestion.descriptionEn: Use regeneration, culture and genetic interventions to distinguish differentiation, senescence and death.

boundaries: Regeneration is a fixed qualitative observation, not generated by a suitable-condition switch. The hypothesis/expression models are separate interpretations.
DNA/RNA/protein shapes represent programs and products, not named genes or measured 1958 expression data. DNA identity remains; RNA is a new copy.
Textbook 50/20/2–4 values are donor-source culture records, not individual lifespan predictions or measures of all tissues.
1976 culture passage age is distinct from donor age. The 1983 result is inhibition >=40%, displayed as an upper bound <=60%, not a measured mean.
The 15-node branch is illustrative. Canonical 1090=131+959 somatic counts are independent aggregate bookkeeping, not all cells simultaneously present.
CED-4→CED-3 is a simplified classical execution relation. Other regulators, residual pathways and death types are outside this depiction.
Senescence/proliferation arrest, apoptosis and necrotic injury must not be used interchangeably. No claim that every necrotic death is necessarily unregulated.

culture.0-15: Fixed reported regeneration reconstruction, source sample explicit
culture.15-26: Compare required-information loss hypothesis with the same observation; result does not change
culture.26-39: Same DNA program IDs; selected RNA copy moves separately, then protein/structure appears; root/shoot explanatory selection

prediction.state: Retained DNA remains visible while the result is qualified: retention does not guarantee regeneration under different cell states/conditions.

direction.age: Immutable textbook records under matched conditions; intact cell emphasizes division arrest != death. Exploration only changes comparability, not source data.
direction.nuclear: Two textbook source comparisons; independent progress 2–10s and 12–23s keeps each phone transfer continuous. Source identity survives entry into recipient.
direction.limits: 1976 and1983 remain separate studies;1983 boundary-derived bar, not a precise observed mean.
direction.lineage: Mother appears before daughters, fixed local identities and independent canonical tally.
direction.genes: Compare local-10 after birth (lineageProgress >=.72). Normal and intervention have identical birth identity and parent; only execution changes. Existing CED colors do not serve as sole evidence.

sourceEvidenceAddendum.geneticNecessity: Ellis & Horvitz 1986: intervention and survival evidence.
sourceEvidenceAddendum.activationDirection: Chinnaiyan et al. 1997: later CED-4-mediated CED-3 activation evidence.
sourceEvidenceAddendum.scope: Simplified execution relationship; other regulators, ATP binding and complete assembly mechanisms remain outside this depiction.
